steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} and the code it cites. Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card: the prose-extraction fn (namespace, signature, the exact rules for Claude's ⏺ prose vs tool lines, with screen fixtures you capture from a real pane and check for paths/PII), the state/crew-said.edn shape and who writes it, the game's new :crew-said lines and the question '!', the unknown-prompt Allow/Always/No line, bb crew-answer (CLI, bridge endpoint, validation), the forwarding of fielder-left prompts to the twin's chat, the --as fix, numbered test cases with hand-checked expected values, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src/ and scripts/ files you name, bb.edn, resources/estate.edn only if needed; tester: new test files only, plus test/fixtures/; le-docteur: crew/README.md's crew-talk section and PLAY.md only if the player-facing 💭 changes). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying, then write {run}/builder-notes.md as the quest's Done-when says.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check in particular: only prose crosses from a pane (no tool output, paths, file contents); state/crew.edn gains no screen text; crew-answer goes through the same prompt-id/hash check and is refused stale; hold on stops the fielder and the forwarding; the player can still answer first; risky prompts keep the ⚠ and reason; --as lines reach the member's thread; no person, pet or member named in code; no npm deps. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
